facts.hand-pentacle: A hand coming out of a cloud on the left holds a large gold pentacle on its palm.
facts.glow: Pale rays of light spread around the hand.
facts.garden-lilies: White lilies bloom in the garden below.
facts.hedge-arch: An arched gateway is cut into the hedge, and a path continues beyond it.
facts.mountains: Blue mountains can be seen beyond the arch.
facts.lawn-path: A yellow path runs through the green lawn.

glosses.hedge-arch: A door leading out of the garden; the path that carries an opportunity into reality.
glosses.garden-lilies: A foundation that grows in proportion to the care given.

reversedGloss.blocked: An opportunity is there, but preparation or conditions block it, and the start is late.
reversedGloss.excess: Too tied to money and conditions.

misdescriptions.wrong: A hand comes out of a cloud on the right.
